# M(eaux)tion Fitness

> > A movement-focused fitness resource emphasizing bodyweight training, calisthenics, and generalist movement approaches inspired by Ido Portal, Pavel Tsatsouline, and Animal Flow methodologies.

M(eaux)tion Fitness promotes a non-specialized approach to fitness, featuring guides on bodyweight exercises, progressive strength building, and movement practices. The site covers practical training methods from influential coaches like Ido Portal and Pavel Tsatsouline, with detailed tutorials on advanced calisthenics movements and equipment recommendations.

## Key Topics

- Bodyweight training
- Ido Portal Method
- Animal Flow
- Calisthenics
- Movement training
- Pavel Tsatsouline
- Progressive overload
- Crawling exercises
- Push-up variations
- Pistol squats
- The Naked Warrior
- Locomotion training
- Strength building
- Home gym equipment
- Generalist movement approach

## Getting Started

- [M(eaux)tion Fitness](https://meauxtion.com): Homepage featuring lizard crawl exercises and Ido Portal training methods
- [My Philosophy](https://meauxtion.com/about): Training philosophy on generalist movement approach and fitness confusion
- [Popular Articles](https://meauxtion.com/how-to-use-this-blog): Curated list of popular articles on kettlebells, air bikes, and movement

## Bodyweight Strength Training

- [How to Build Bodyweight Strength: 1-Arm Push Ups and Pistols](https://meauxtion.com/2013/03/19/how-to-build-bodyweight-strength-1-arm-push-ups-and-pistols): Bodyweight strength guide inspired by Pavel Tsatsouline's Naked Warrior
- [5 Quick Benefits and Ideas About Push-Ups](https://meauxtion.com/2021/04/05/5-quick-benefits-and-ideas-about-push-ups): Push-up benefits and variations for upper body strength building
- [How to Make Bodyweight Push-Ups HARDER (and less boring)](https://meauxtion.com/2020/12/04/how-to-make-bodyweight-push-ups-harder-and-less-boring): Push-up variations to increase difficulty and prevent workout boredom
- [A Guide to Performing Your First Dragon Pistol Squat](https://meauxtion.com/2021/02/25/a-guide-to-performing-your-first-dragon-pistol-squat): Beginner guide to dragon pistol squats with progressions and drills

## Equipment & Workouts

- [Air Bike Workouts| 5-Mile Ride for Time](https://meauxtion.com/2017/01/04/the-5-mile-air-bike-ride-for-time): Middle-distance air bike workout using Schwinn Airdyne or Assault Bike
- [Gear](https://meauxtion.com/gear): Recommended fitness gear including ANCORE trainer and athletic apparel

## Programs & Resources

- [Products](https://meauxtion.com/about/products): Recommended fitness programs including Animal Flow and Ido Portal Method
- [Trickery & Timeless One Liners to Help Guide Your Lean Eating](https://meauxtion.com/2012/08/07/trickery-timeless-one-liners-to-help-guide-your-lean-eating): Simple nutrition advice and whole foods eating guidelines for fat loss
